intro.en: Two friends, Omar and Bashir, meet at the hospital. One has a toothache and the other a sore throat. Learn to ask «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» (what do you feel?) and to name parts of the body.
intro.ur: Do dost, Omar aur Bashir, hospital mein milte hain. Ek ke daant mein dard hai aur doosre ka gala dukhta hai. «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» (aap kya mehsoos karte hain?) poochna aur jism ke hisson ke naam seekhein.
intro.ar: يَلْتَقي صَديقانِ، عُمَرُ وَبَشيرٌ، في المُسْتَشْفى: أَحَدُهُما يَشْكو مِنْ أَلَمٍ في أَسْنانِهِ وَالآخَرُ في حَنْجَرَتِهِ. تَعَلَّمْ أَنْ تَسْأَلَ «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» وَأَسْماءَ أَعْضاءِ الجِسْمِ.

dialogue.tr: ahlan yā Bashīr, ṣabāḥu l-khayr
dialogue.en: Hello, Bashir, good morning.
dialogue.ur: Bashir, khush amdeed, subah bakhair.

dialogue.ar: صَباحُ النّورِ يا عُمَرُ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ.
dialogue.tr: ṣabāḥu n-nūr yā ʿUmar, as-salāmu ʿalayk
dialogue.en: Good morning, Omar, peace be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Subah bakhair Omar, aap par salami ho.

dialogue.tr: limādhā anta fī l-mustashfā l-yawm?
dialogue.en: Why are you at the hospital today?
dialogue.ur: Aap aaj hospital mein kyun hain?

dialogue.ar: أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ في أَسْنانِي، فَحَضَرْتُ إِلى طَبيبِ الأَسْنانِ.
dialogue.tr: ashʿuru bi-alamin fī asnānī, fa-ḥaḍartu ilā ṭabībi l-asnān
dialogue.en: I feel pain in my teeth, so I came to the dentist.
dialogue.ur: Mere daanton mein dard hai, is liye main daanton ke doctor ke paas aaya.

dialogue.tr: wa anta, bima tashʿuru yā ʿUmar?
dialogue.en: And you, what do you feel, Omar?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap, Omar, aap kya mehsoos karte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في حَنْجَرَتي، وَفي أَنْفي أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: ashʿuru bi-alamin shadīdin fī ḥanjaratī, wa fī anfī ayḍan
dialogue.en: I feel a severe pain in my throat, and in my nose too.
dialogue.ur: Mere gale mein shadeed dard hai, aur meri naak mein bhi.

dialogue.tr: idhan sa-tuqābilu ṭabība l-ḥanjara
dialogue.en: So you will meet the throat doctor.
dialogue.ur: To aap gale ke doctor se milenge.

dialogue.tr: naʿam, wa huwa ṭabībun jayyid
dialogue.en: Yes, and he is a good doctor.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, aur woh achha doctor hai.

dialogue.tr: hal ḥajazta mawʿidan?
dialogue.en: Did you book an appointment?
dialogue.ur: Kya aapne waqt (appointment) liya hai?

dialogue.tr: naʿam, mawʿidī baʿda niṣfi sāʿa
dialogue.en: Yes, my appointment is in half an hour.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, mera waqt aadhe ghante baad ka hai.

dialogue.tr: wa mawʿidī baʿda sāʿatin taqrīban
dialogue.en: And my appointment is in about an hour.
dialogue.ur: Aur mera waqt takreeban ek ghante baad ka hai.

dialogue.tr: as-sāʿatu l-āna t-tāsiʿatu wa n-niṣf
dialogue.en: It is now half past nine.
dialogue.ur: Ab saadhe nau baje hain.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ، الباقي نِصْفُ ساعَةٍ لِمَوْعِدِكَ، لا بَأْسَ.
dialogue.tr: idhan, l-bāqī niṣfu sāʿatin li-mawʿidika, lā baʾs
dialogue.en: Then half an hour remains for your appointment. No problem.
dialogue.ur: To aapke waqt mein aadha ghanta baqi hai, koi baat nahi.

q.en: How do you ask «What do you feel?»
q.ur: «Aap ko kya mehsoos ho raha hai?» Arabi mein kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ مَريضًا عَمّا يَشْعُرُ بِهِ؟

q.en: Omar says «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في حَنْجَرَتي». What is hurting?
q.ur: Omar kehta hai «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في حَنْجَرَتي». Kya dukh raha hai?

options_ar: أَعْضاءٌ في الفَمِ نَمْضَغُ بِها الطَّعامَ

intro.en: A girl was absent from school because of a bad cold. Her teacher asks what happened, and the girl tells about her headache, the ambulance and the doctor's advice.
intro.ur: Ek talibah bohat zukam ki wajah se school se ghair-haazir thi. Ustani poochti hain ke kya hua, aur talibah sar dard, ambulance aur doctor ki naseehat ke bare mein batati hai.
intro.ar: غابَتْ طالِبَةٌ عَنِ المَدْرَسَةِ بِسَبَبِ زُكامٍ شَديدٍ. تَسْأَلُها المُعَلِّمَةُ عَمّا حَدَثَ، فَتَحْكي عَنِ الصُّداعِ وَالإِسْعافِ وَنَصيحَةِ الطَّبيبِ.

dialogue.ar: صَباحُ الخَيْرِ يا سارَةُ، هَلْ تَغَيَّبْتِ أَمْسِ؟
dialogue.tr: ṣabāḥu l-khayr yā Sāra, hal taghayyabti amsi?
dialogue.en: Good morning, Sara. Were you absent yesterday?
dialogue.ur: Subah bakhair Sara, kya aap kal ghair-haazir thin?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ يا مُعَلِّمَتي، أَصابَني زُكامٌ شَديدٌ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam yā muʿallimatī, aṣābanī zukāmun shadīd
dialogue.en: Yes, teacher, a bad cold struck me.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan ustani ji, mujhe sakht zukam ho gaya.

dialogue.tr: wa bima shaʿarti?
dialogue.en: And what did you feel?
dialogue.ur: Aur aapne kya mehsoos kiya?

dialogue.ar: اِرْتَفَعَتْ حَرارَتي مَساءً، وَشَعَرْتُ بِصُداعٍ في رَأْسي.
dialogue.tr: irtafaʿat ḥarāratī masāʾan, wa shaʿartu bi-ṣudāʿin fī raʾsī
dialogue.en: My temperature rose in the evening, and I felt a headache in my head.
dialogue.ur: Shaam ko mera bukhar chadh gaya, aur mere sar mein dard hua.

dialogue.tr: hal qābalti ṭ-ṭabīb?
dialogue.en: Did you meet the doctor?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap doctor se mili thin?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، أَخَذَني أَبي بِالإِسْعافِ إِلى المُسْتَشْفى.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, akhadhanī abī bil-isʿāfi ilā l-mustashfā
dialogue.en: Yes, my father took me to the hospital by ambulance.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, mere abbu mujhe ambulance se hospital le gaye.

dialogue.tr: wa mādhā naṣaḥaki ṭ-ṭabīb?
dialogue.en: And what did the doctor advise you?
dialogue.ur: Aur doctor ne aapko kya naseehat ki?

dialogue.ar: نَصَحَني بِالرّاحَةِ في البَيْتِ، وَبِتَناوُلِ الدَّواءِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: naṣaḥanī bir-rāḥati fī l-bayt, wa bi-tanāwuli d-dawāʾi kulla yawm
dialogue.en: He advised me to rest at home and to take medicine every day.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne mujhe ghar par aaraam aur har roz dawa lene ki naseehat ki.

dialogue.ar: وَهَذا هُوَ التَّقْريرُ الطِّبِّيُّ يا مُعَلِّمَتي.
dialogue.tr: wa hādhā huwa t-taqrīru ṭ-ṭibbiyy yā muʿallimatī
dialogue.en: And this is the medical report, teacher.
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh medical report hai, ustani ji.

dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh, wa kayfa ṣiḥḥatuki l-ān?
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah. And how is your health now?
dialogue.ur: Alhamdulillah, aur ab aapki sehat kaisi hai?

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَفْضَلُ بِكَثيرٍ يا مُعَلِّمَتي، شُكْراً.
dialogue.tr: anā afḍalu bi-kathīrin yā muʿallimatī, shukran
dialogue.en: I am much better, teacher, thank you.
dialogue.ur: Main bohat behtar hoon ustani ji, shukriya.

dialogue.tr: salāmatuki yā Sāra, wa shafāki llāh
dialogue.en: Get well, Sara, and may Allah heal you.
dialogue.ur: Allah aapko sehat de, Sara, aur shifa ata farmaye.

vocab.ur: wo beemar ya zakhmi hota hai

options: rest and medicine / aaraam aur dawa

intro.en: Layla asks her grandmother about her visit to the doctor. Learn about the heart, blood pressure and healthy food, and how to wish someone well: «شَفاكِ اللهُ».
intro.ur: Layla apni nani/dadi se doctor ke paas jaane ke bare mein poochti hai. Dil, blood pressure aur sehatmand khane ke bare mein seekhein, aur beemar ke liye dua dena: «شَفاكِ اللهُ».
intro.ar: تَسْأَلُ لَيْلى جَدَّتَها عَنْ زِيارَتِها لِلطَّبيبِ. تَعَلَّمْ عَنِ القَلْبِ وَضَغْطِ الدَّمِ وَالطَّعامِ الصِّحِّيِّ، وَكَيْفَ تَدْعو لِمَريضَةٍ: «شَفاكِ اللهُ».

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يا جَدَّتي، كَيْفَ كانَتْ زِيارَةُ الطَّبيبِ؟
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalayki yā jaddatī, kayfa kānat ziyāratu ṭ-ṭabīb?
dialogue.en: Peace be upon you, grandmother. How was the visit to the doctor?
dialogue.ur: Assalamu alaikum dadi jaan, doctor ke paas jana kaisa raha?

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكِ السَّلامُ يا حَبيبَتي، كانَتْ جَيِّدَةً بِحَمْدِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalayki s-salāmu yā ḥabībatī, kānat jayyidatan bi-ḥamdi llāh
dialogue.en: And peace be upon you, my dear. It was good, praise be to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Wa alaikum assalam meri pyari, alhamdulillah achha raha.

dialogue.tr: mādhā faḥaṣa ṭ-ṭabīb?
dialogue.en: What did the doctor examine?
dialogue.ur: Doctor ne kya check kiya?

dialogue.ar: قاسَ ضَغْطي أَوَّلاً، ثُمَّ فَحَصَ قَلْبي وَصَدْري وَكُلْيَتي.
dialogue.tr: qāsa ḍaghṭī awwalan, thumma faḥaṣa qalbī wa ṣadrī wa kulyatī
dialogue.en: He measured my pressure first, then examined my heart, chest and kidney.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne pehle mera pressure naapa, phir dil, seena aur gurda dekha.

dialogue.tr: wa mā n-natīja yā jaddatī?
dialogue.en: And what is the result, grandmother?
dialogue.ur: Aur nateeja kya hai, dadi jaan?

dialogue.ar: قَلْبي سَليمٌ، وَلَكِنَّ الضَّغْطَ مُرْتَفِعٌ قَليلاً.
dialogue.tr: qalbī salīm, wa lākinna ḍ-ḍaghṭa murtafiʿun qalīlan
dialogue.en: My heart is healthy, but the pressure is a little high.
dialogue.ur: Mera dil theek hai, lekin blood pressure thoda zyada hai.

dialogue.tr: mā sababu dhālik?
dialogue.en: What is the reason for that?
dialogue.ur: Iski wajah kya hai?

dialogue.ar: السَّبَبُ زِيادَةُ الوَزْنِ، لِأَنّي آكُلُ السُّكَّرِيّاتِ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: as-sababu ziyādatu l-wazn, li-annī ākulu s-sukkariyyāti kathīran
dialogue.en: The reason is weight gain, because I eat many sweets.
dialogue.ur: Wajah wazan ka barhna hai, kyunke main meethi cheezein bohat khati hoon.

dialogue.tr: wa bimādhā naṣaḥaki ṭ-ṭabīb?
dialogue.en: And what did the doctor advise you?
dialogue.ur: Aur doctor ne aapko kya naseehat ki?

dialogue.ar: نَصَحَني بِتَرْكِ السُّكَّرِيّاتِ، وَبِالمَشْيِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: naṣaḥanī bi-tarki s-sukkariyyāt, wa bil-mashyi kulla yawm
dialogue.en: He advised me to give up sweets and to walk every day.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne meethi cheezein chhorne aur har roz chalne ki naseehat ki.

dialogue.tr: wa mādhā naʾkulu li-nakūna bi-ṣiḥḥatin jayyida?
dialogue.en: And what do we eat to be in good health?
dialogue.ur: Aur achhi sehat ke liye hum kya khayein?

dialogue.tr: naʾkulu l-fawākiha wa l-khuḍrāwāti kulla yawm
dialogue.en: We eat fruits and vegetables every day.
dialogue.ur: Hum har roz phal aur sabziyan khayein.

dialogue.tr: shafāki llāhu yā jaddatī
dialogue.en: May Allah heal you, grandmother.
dialogue.ur: Allah aapko shifa de, dadi jaan.

dialogue.ar: آمينَ يا حَبيبَتي، جَزاكِ اللهُ خَيْراً.
dialogue.tr: āmīn yā ḥabībatī, jazāki llāhu khayran
dialogue.en: Ameen, my dear. May Allah reward you.
dialogue.ur: Ameen meri pyari, Allah tumhein jazaye khair de.

q.en: What does Layla say to wish her grandmother well?
q.ur: Layla apni dadi ko sehat ki dua kaise deti hai?
q.ar: ماذا تَقولُ لَيْلى لِجَدَّتِها لِتَدْعُوَ لَها بِالشِّفاءِ؟

q.en: What does the doctor advise her to give up?
q.ur: Doctor ne unhein kya chhorne ki naseehat ki?
q.ar: بِماذا نَصَحَ الطَّبيبُ الجَدَّةَ أَنْ تَتْرُكَ؟

intro.en: Here you learn the tens: twenty, thirty, forty … up to a hundred and a thousand. There are also matching practice slides for body parts.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum dahaiyan seekhenge: bees, tees, chalees… sau aur hazaar tak. Saath mein jism ke hisson ko tasweer se milane ki mashq bhi hai.
intro.ar: هُنا تَتَعَلَّمُ العُقودَ: عِشْرون، ثَلاثون، أَرْبَعون … إِلى مِئَةٍ وَأَلْفٍ. وَفيها تَمارينُ مُطابَقَةٍ لِأَعْضاءِ الجِسْمِ.

intro.en: Practise asking and answering in pairs. «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في أُذُني.» Also «لِماذا حَضَرْتَ إلى…؟» (why did you come to…?) and «هَلْ لَدَيْكَ مَوْعِدٌ مَعَ…؟».
intro.ur: Dost ke saath sawal jawab ki mashq karein. «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في أُذُني.» Phir «لِماذا حَضَرْتَ إلى…؟» (aap kyun aaye?) aur «هَلْ لَدَيْكَ مَوْعِدٌ مَعَ…؟» (kya aap ka waqt hai?).
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ: «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في أُذُني.» وَكَذَلِكَ «لِماذا حَضَرْتَ إِلى…؟» وَ«هَلْ لَدَيْكَ مَوْعِدٌ مَعَ…؟».

options: I came to meet the dentist / Main daanton ke doctor se milne aaya
I went home / Main ghar gaya
I felt a pain in my nose / Meri naak mein dard hai
I eat fruit / Main phal khata hoon
Do you have an appointment? / Kya aap ka waqt liya hua hai?
Where is the doctor? / Doctor kahan hai?
What is your name? / Aap ka naam kya hai?
How old are you? / Aap ki umar kya hai?
options_ar: عَمّا إِذا كانَ عِنْدَهُ وَقْتٌ مَحْجوزٌ

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz «kyun» ka matlab rakhta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ السَّبَبِ؟

q.en: Which sentence says «my appointment is at the ninth hour»?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla kehta hai «mera waqt nau baje hai»?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَقولُ إِنَّ المَوْعِدَ في السّاعَةِ التّاسِعَةِ؟

intro.en: Listen and repeat the long «ـُ / و» sound (as in مَحْمود and ثَلاثون). Then listen to a short story about Ahmad and Ammar and answer the questions.
intro.ur: Suniye aur dohraiye: lambi «ـُ / و» ki awaaz (jaise مَحْمود aur ثَلاثون mein). Phir Ahmad aur Ammar ki chhoti kahani sun kar sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ وَكَرِّرْ صَوْتَ الواوِ الطَّويلَةِ بَعْدَ الضَّمَّةِ كَما في مَحْمود وَثَلاثون. ثُمَّ اسْتَمِعْ إِلى قِصَّةٍ قَصيرَةٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ وَعَمّارٍ وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

q.en: Which word has the long «و» sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi «و» ki awaaz hai?

q.en: Which word has the long «و» sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi «و» ki awaaz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ أُخْرى فيها واوُ مَدٍّ؟

options: What did Ahmad feel? / Ahmad ne kya mehsoos kiya?
Where did Ahmad go? / Ahmad kahan gaya?
Who is Ahmad? / Ahmad kaun hai?
When did Ahmad eat? / Ahmad ne kab khaya?
How are Ahmad's teeth? / Ahmad ke daant kaise hain?
How old is Ahmad? / Ahmad ki umar kya hai?
Where is Ahmad? / Ahmad kahan hai?
What is Ahmad's name? / Ahmad ka naam kya hai?

intro.en: Talk with a friend using the pictures. «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ في صَدْري. وَبِمَ تَشْعُرُ أَنْتَ؟» Also «هَلْ قابَلْتَ الطَّبيب؟» – «نَعَم، وَفَحَصَ القَلْب.»
intro.ur: Tasweeron ki madad se dost ke saath baat karein. «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ في صَدْري. وَبِمَ تَشْعُرُ أَنْتَ؟» Aur «هَلْ قابَلْتَ الطَّبيب؟» – «نَعَم، وَفَحَصَ القَلْب.»
intro.ar: تَحَدَّثْ مَعَ صَديقِكَ مُسْتَعيناً بِالصُّوَرِ: «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ في صَدْري. وَبِمَ تَشْعُرُ أَنْتَ؟» وَكَذَلِكَ «هَلْ قابَلْتَ الطَّبيبَ؟» – «نَعَمْ، وَفَحَصَ القَلْبَ.»

q.en: How do you say «I feel pain in my chest»?
q.ur: «Mere seene mein dard hai» Arabi mein kaise kahenge?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَقولُها إِذا كانَ الأَلَمُ في صَدْرِكَ؟
قيلَ: «ما النَّتيجَةُ؟» – «القَلْبُ سَليمٌ». ما السَّليمُ هُنا؟

options: What does Badr eat? / Badr kya khata hai?
Where is Badr? / Badr kahan hai?
How is Badr? / Badr kaisa hai?
What does Badr feel? / Badr ko kya mehsoos hota hai?

intro.en: Read short texts about people who go to the doctor: Ahmad has a heart check, Kawthar has a headache and fever, and a grandfather who is eighty years old stays healthy.
intro.ur: Un logon ke bare mein chhote matn parhiye jo doctor ke paas jaate hain: Ahmad ke dil ka muaina, Kauthar ko sar dard aur bukhar, aur assi saal ke dada jo sehatmand hain.
intro.ar: اِقْرَأْ نُصوصًا قَصيرَةً عَمَّنْ يَذْهَبونَ إِلى الطَّبيبِ: أَحْمَدُ يَفْحَصُ قَلْبَهُ، وَكَوْثَرُ تَشْكو مِنْ صُداعٍ وَحُمّى، وَجَدٌّ عُمْرُهُ ثَمانونَ سَنَةً وَما زالَ بِصِحَّةٍ جَيِّدَةٍ.

q.ur: Ahmad ka waqt kab ka hai?

q.en: What did the doctor advise Ahmad?
q.ur: Doctor ne Ahmad ko kya naseehat ki?

q.en: Kawthar went to the ear doctor. What did she feel?
q.ur: Kauthar kaan ke doctor ke paas gayi. Usay kya mehsoos hua?
q.ar: ذَهَبَتْ كَوْثَرُ إِلى طَبيبِ الأُذُنِ. بِمَ شَعَرَتْ؟

intro.en: Match words, arrange words into sentences, fill the gaps, and write health words such as زُكام (cold), أُذُن (ear) and تَقْرير (report) letter by letter.
intro.ur: Lafzon ko milaiye, lafzon ko jumle mein tarteeb dein, khaali jagah bharein, aur sehat ke alfaaz jaise زُكام (zukam), أُذُن (kaan) aur تَقْرير (report) harf ba harf likhein.
intro.ar: طابِقِ الكَلِماتِ، وَرَتِّبْها لِتُكَوِّنَ جُمَلًا، وَأَكْمِلِ الفَراغاتِ، وَاكْتُبْ كَلِماتِ الصِّحَّةِ مِثْلَ زُكام وَأُذُن وَتَقْرير حَرْفًا حَرْفًا.

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz «report» ka matlab rakhta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني وَرَقَةً يَكْتُبُ فيها الطَّبيبُ نَتيجَةَ الفَحْصِ؟

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz «waqt (appointment)» ka matlab rakhta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني الوَقْتَ المُحَدَّدَ لِلِقاءِ الطَّبيبِ؟

options: May Allah heal you / Allah aap ko shifa de
